verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents admin-enforced org-wide policies: no app-lock requirements, no export restrictions, no master-password strength rules pushed to members' apps. The nearest items are the Events API, which only retrieves activity for SIEM monitoring, and user-initiated export, which is the opposite of restricting it; neither is policy enforcement.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
